title: District Commission Officers' and Employees' Functions

content.scenario: An officer of a District Commission is unsure about the proper procedure to follow in a particular case. The officer seeks guidance from the President of the District Commission.
content.outcome: The officers and other employees of the District Commission shall discharge their functions under the general superintendence of the President of the District Commission.

user_queries: Who supervises the officers and employees of a District Commission?
What is the role of the President of a District Commission in relation to its officers and employees?
How do officers and employees of a District Commission discharge their functions?
